'''MistHunter Dark Side: Any Methods Necessary''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[MistHunter]]
* '''Published:''' 9 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Dungeon|JP-D-jabbaspalacedungeon.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Dungeon
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Jabba's Palace Dungeon MistHunte.txt |Download]]

Bounty Hunters

The published list has 61 cards.
